name: OpenComputer
description: Open-source (Apache-2.0) cloud coding agent: mention @Computer in Slack with a task and it works in its own cloud computer, then opens a pull request. Self-host or use the hosted plans.
offer: **50% off** Pro and Max with **double the work minutes**, applied at checkout; no code needed. Pro **$10/month** with 4,000 minutes (regular $20, 2,000); Max **$100/month** with 50,000 minutes (regular $200, 25,000). First 50 workspaces keep it for 12 months, later ones for 3 months. One claim per workspace without an active paid Pro or Max subscription, including workspaces on a free trial.
